MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these choices gave me a strong enough connection to my recent listening to make me want to interact.",
    "The Beethoven collection and Brother Bear did not fit what I wanted to hear now; simply being music was not enough.",
    "The named artist retrospectives did not connect clearly enough with my recent choices, while titles like Thank You and Greatest Hits left me unsure what music I would get."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The selections felt as though my interest in a few albums meant I would want a broad range of music collections.",
    "A greatest-hits or anthology format alone does not make something appealing to me; the actual music needs to fit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas album choices suggest a specific listening occasion, rather than a general interest in any established artist's catalog.",
    "Those Christmas choices were close together in November 2014, while my latest interaction was The New Old Fashioned in September 2016. I would want choices that connect with that newer interest without assuming I am still shopping for holiday music.",
    "I interact rarely, so a loose connection is unlikely to prompt me to explore; I need a clear reason to expect music I want to hear."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in music but missed the specific listening connections that would make a choice feel relevant now."
}
